title: Rumi Ramen? ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Cook Up Instant Noodle Collab That You Can Buy Online Now
summary: Each HUNTR/X member gets her own ramen flavor as part of the Nongshim collaboration.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Since its release, KPop Demon Hunters has become more than just a film — it has grown into a global phenomenon with an increasingly growing lineup of merchandise. The film has expanded beyond the screen with Mattel dolls , Little People Collector Sets , Squishmallows and even a Vans sneaker collab . And now, you can get ramen noodles inspired by the HUNTR/X members.

Yes, KPop Demon Hunters is getting in the ramen game with a new collaboration with South Korean instant noodle company Nongshim. The collection features unique ramen flavors inspired by Rumi, Zoey and Mira, with each character represented by a signature flavor and a uniquely colored cup that reflects their identity. The noodle theme also connects directly to the movie, in which HUNTR/X members are seen enjoying noodles together during moments between concerts and demon-hunting.

SPICY & SMOKY

Rumi Superstar Instant Ramen Noodle Cup

6-Pack

Inspired by Rumi’s superstar qualities, this Shin Ramyun cup features a “superstar” flavor, with a spicy broth with savory ham and meaty notes.

The firm, springy noodles are designed to hold the rich broth for a satisfying bite. A flake packet adds star-shaped fish cake, ham-style fish cake, dried kimchi and bok choy for extra texture and flavor. Each cup is microwave-ready for quick preparation.

HAMBURGER TASTE

Zoey Burger Hero Instant Ramen Noodle Cup

Zoey’s “Burger Hero” flavor combines Shin Ramyun noodles with a savory hamburger-inspired broth featuring rich, smoky notes.

The chewy noodles pair with the bold seasoning for a familiar yet spicy ramen experience. A vegetable flake packet includes bok choy, mushroom, carrot, green onion and red chili pepper to add texture and depth. Each cup in this six-pack is ready in minutes with boiling water or microwave preparation.

GOURMET SPICY

Mira Spicy Queen Instant Ramen Noodle Cup

Mira’s “Spicy Queen” Shin Ramyun cup delivers the signature heat and savory depth that you’d expect from Shin Ramyun and the HUNTR/X lead dancer.

The bold spicy broth is paired with firm, chewy noodles that absorb the rich flavors with every bite. A dried garnish packet adds vegetables, color and aroma to enhance the overall ramen experience.

BEEF-FLAVORED

Shin Ramyun Beef-Flavored Instant Ramen Noodle Cup

$12.57

With HUNTR/X branding, this Shin Ramyun cup features a rich beef-flavored broth with the signature spicy taste that made the brand popular worldwide.

The included soup base can be adjusted to customize the heat level, while the chewy noodles provide a satisfying texture. Add toppings such as kimchi, dumplings or cheese to personalize each serving. Ready with hot water or microwave preparation.

SAJA BOYS RAMEN

Shin Ramyun Toomba Creamy Korean Mac and Cheese

$10.15

A creamy Korean stir-fry-style instant noodle inspired by Korean mac and cheese, featuring a rich, velvety sauce with a mild spicy kick.

Branded with KPop Demon Hunters ‘ Saja Boys, each microwaveable square bowl is ready in minutes for a quick meal or snack. The creamy sauce also pairs well with toppings like shrimp, pork, vegetables or extra cheese.
